title: World Bloom — With You at SEKAI's Beginnings — Episode5 Songs to Spread Hope

meta.Event Outline: From their space between worlds, Miku and the others watch over everyone. Just then, a fragment appears before them. It takes them to see everyone at the moment their true feelings were born.

rows.Line: Wow, look at how big this stage is...!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I saw lots of stages back there, but this one seems to be the biggest!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
And this crowd's huge...!
This is so cool...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: That's what the owners of the feeling which made this SEKAI feel...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I also want to spread hope to everyone as an idol!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I know your wishes are going to come true!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Everyone! Let's have lots and lots of fun together today!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (Wanting to help them but not being able to was really frustrating...)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (But this me is doing everything she can for them in my place.)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: This stage is so big and there was such a huge crowd here that I couldn't help but start singing♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
What a coincidence!
I was actually just singing over on that stage♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hehe. I wish I could've seen your performance, Miku.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Still, it's amazing how there are all these stages here...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: They must all represent how Haruka and the others feel.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
*Nod*
I hope we get to meet them soon♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: They must really love idols if their feelings were able to produce this SEKAI.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I have to also think that they're kind and wonderful people who are willing to give their all to bring others hope!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Definitely!
I mean, it's so obvious from all these stages that they really want to spread hope to everyone!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Which means we also gotta do our best, Miku...!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: We'll sing, dance, spread hope and help them discover their true feelings...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: And someday, we're gonna perform on this stage with them!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
(They're both so cheerful and optimistic...
I feel more hopeful after just listening to them.)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: They may not be able to get their feelings across right away...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: But I know the way you two perform is going to inspire so much hope in them.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Okay!
Let's make this the best show ever♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: W-Wait, does this mean I get to see them perform...?!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Hehe...
Since I'm here, I might as well have some fun!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: We're gonna have so much fun together♪
